answer.text: The Aaltonen 56480 winter boots are made of natural suede and feature genuine sheepskin lining for warm insulation and breathability, designed especially for wider feet with robust anti-slip AALTONEN GRIP soles inspired by winter tires. In contrast, the Andres Machado AM6002 cowboy-style boots are crafted from artificial suede, decorated with silver rivets, featuring a Western design, and are made in Spain, focusing more on style with a zipper for convenience.
